sloka: वल्गु स्वरा निकूजन्ति पंपा सलिल गोचराः ।न उद्विजन्ते नरान् दृष्ट्वा वधस्य अकोविदाः शुभाः ॥३-७३-१३॥
transliteration: valgu svarā nikūjanti paṁpā salila gocarāḥ ।na udvijante narān dṛṣṭvā vadhasya akovidāḥ śubhāḥ ॥3-73-13॥

translations.english: Not knowing that they may be killed, the innocent creatures will not be scared of human beings. Both of you can kill and eat the fat birds comparable to balls of ghee.
